document.abstract: The special photographic effects department is the natural result of the difficult problems that develop in motion picture production. Certain stories are written in such a manner that it taxes the ingenuity of this department to the utmost to produce the effects required in bringing to the screen the visual record of scenes described in scripts. Moreover, the public is becoming more and more critical in analyzing the results of trick photography, which necessitates absolute perfection in obtaining the effects.
